title: What is new card: a 900px card on a scrim, left header, Got it button
why: The critic scored the What is new card 2 of 5: no scrim, a 1560px slab, no close or primary, a centred amber title. Now the floor is dimmed behind it, the card is 900px at most, the title sits left in a header row over a rule, and a footer row holds the hint and an amber Got it button. Drawing only: Enter and walking dismiss it exactly as before.
now: What is new card: tidier layout and a Got it button.
